# TriScout v2.4 TAC-OPS

> On-demand ethical passive cybersecurity reconnaissance console and global NPM CLI toolkit for auditing HTTP security headers, DNS topology, and source/credential leaks.

## Core Pages
- [Landing & Auth Portal](https://triscout.quarry.dpdns.org/): Operator authentication with 2FA email OTP and GitHub OAuth.
- [Command Center](https://triscout.quarry.dpdns.org/dashboard): Interactive 11-node DMZ network topology HUD and on-demand target scanner.
- [Reports & Export](https://triscout.quarry.dpdns.org/reports): Export passive audit findings to PDF, JSON, CSV, or email via SMTP.
- [CLI Tool](https://triscout.quarry.dpdns.org/cli): Global NPM CLI usage (`npx @kiran-mondal/triscout`).
- [About & Architecture](https://triscout.quarry.dpdns.org/about): Node.js, Express, Neon Serverless PostgreSQL (RLS), and SSRF guardrail overview.
- [Projects](https://triscout.quarry.dpdns.org/project): Maintainer portfolio by Kiran Mondal.

## Capabilities
- 12-point passive HTTP security header and DOM audit (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, MIME sniffing, cookie flags, CORS).
- Passive detection of exposed API keys and raw stack trace / SQL error leaks.
- Multi-tenant Neon PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS) across `users`, `auth_otps`, and `scan_logs`.
- Token Bucket rate limiting for OTP and scanner requests.

## Responsible Use
TriScout is intended strictly for defensive security testing on systems you own or have explicit authorization to assess.
